heading: Auditing of transactions of territorial and local governments
lead: That all financial transactions of the territorial and local governments herein provided for, including such transactions of all agencies or instrumentalities established or used by such governments, may be audited by the Government Accountability Office, at its discretion, in accordance with chapter 35 of title 31.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: Herein provided for, referred to in text, means provided for in the appropriation act cited as the credit to this section.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section is from the appropriation act cited as the credit to this section.
